title: Tier pages and category pages have no simulator
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, one range from $0.00 with Default on Markup % 50.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Open Settings › Categories.
  4. Click category A's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page shows its Pricing tab with the list of matrices.
  • No Price Part Simulator shows on the page.

Step 3:

  • The Categories list shows category A.

Step 4:

  • Category A's page shows matrix A's grid.
  • No Price Part Simulator shows under the grid.
